stem: Orbit Claims sees frequent short-lived Lambda database connections causing connection-limit alarms and wants lower failover disruption during Multi-AZ events.

choices.text: Move credentials to AWS KMS keys only and keep direct client-to-database connections.
Place Amazon RDS Proxy in front of the database to pool connections and improve failover behavior.
Use AWS DataSync agents to keep idle connection pools warm.
Use Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing as the database connection pooling layer.

rationale: RDS Proxy is designed for high connection churn patterns and can reduce observed failover disruption for Multi-AZ instances. KMS key storage does not pool runtime DB connections. Route 53 routing is DNS traffic control, not SQL connection multiplexing. DataSync handles data transfer jobs, not connection lifecycle management.
